title: History-Compatible Energy-Stable Finite Element Schemes for Variable-Density Cahn--Hilliard--Navier--Stokes Flows on Evolving Meshes
summary: We consider variable-density Cahn--Hilliard--Navier--Stokes (CHNS) discretizations on finite element meshes that may change between accepted time levels through fixed-topology motion or topology-changing remeshing. When the discrete spaces vary in time, the phase, kinetic, and pressure histories entering a multistep scheme are measured in different discrete structures and cannot, in general, be transferred by a single operator.
